verification_policy: Single-skill Ki Blast Super research: reconcile canonical class, counter taxonomy, acquisition, DLC provenance, mechanics, and Ultimate Finish evidence. Unsupported fields remain null.
research_scope: Counter Impact — Ki Blast Super / counter taxonomy research.

verification_audit.method: Reconciled repository research with current Xenoverse 2-specific Counter Impact documentation, character data, DLC documentation, and reward-route evidence.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No duplicate repository research batch was found; Counter Impact remains a single Super Skill identity.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Counter Impact is a Ki Blast Super and Counter Skill. The move's in-game description specifically says it deflects melee attacks; the repository does not generalize that into a universal all-attack counter.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Counter Impact is obtained from PQ153 — Seeing Double. Xenoverse 2-specific documentation identifies Vegeta (GT) as its user, and official Bandai Namco DLC documentation identifies the Conton City Vote Pack as adding Vegeta (GT), four PQs, and ten moves.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: Counter Impact is one of the ten additional moves associated with the Conton City Vote Pack, and PQ153 is one of that pack's four Parallel Quests.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains false because PQ153 reward evidence places Counter Impact in the Basic Reward list.
verification_audit.cost_policy: 100 Ki remains verified; stamina cost and drop probability remain null.
verification_audit.availability_policy: Current Xenoverse 2 character documentation identifies Vegeta (GT) as a cast character and does not mark Counter Impact as a CaC-obtainable skill in the selected evidence; usable_by_cac therefore remains null rather than inferred.

records.name: Counter Impact
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Counter Impact under PQ153 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: Enter a defensive stance to deflect a melee attack, then warp behind the opponent. Holding the input extends the follow-up into a Ki Wave.
records.mechanics_notes: The in-game description states that the user enters a stance to deflect melee attacks, then warps behind the opponent; holding the input continues the warp and unleashes a Ki Wave. The Ki Wave is documented at approximately 15% damage. Counter Impact is categorized as a Counter Skill, but the specific trigger evidence is melee rather than a universal counter, so no broader trigger claim is made.
records.acquisition_notes: Future Warrior acquisition route is PQ153 — Seeing Double. Repository reward evidence places Counter Impact in the Basic Reward list. Official Bandai Namco identifies the Conton City Vote Pack as adding Vegeta (GT), four Parallel Quests, and ten additional moves, establishing the DLC provenance.
records.pve_notes: PQ153 is the documented farming route. Basic-reward evidence means no separate Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded.
records.pvp_notes: Community discussion describes the move as a defensive teleport/vanish-like counter with an optional Ki Blast follow-up. Exact frame advantage, matchup behavior, and version-sensitive timing are not promoted to canonical fields.
